Results_1_Internal_Model_Selection.key_message: Improved ConvNeXt-Tiny achieved the highest locked internal independent-test Macro F1.

Results_2_External_Validation.key_message: Performance decreased sharply on PlantDoc, with strongly class-dependent external errors.

Results_3_Domain_Generalization.key_message: The severe performance gap remained after strict same-class comparison and was accompanied by substantial external overconfidence.

Results_4_Explainability.key_message: Selected external errors showed multiple attention failure patterns including background/context dependence, weak symptom localization, and incorrect class discrimination despite plausible localization.
